tasks.name: I1 — bound patchIdAggregateTellMerged (git.ts)

Add --no-ext-diff to patchId's `git diff` (git.ts:554). Reorder contentMergedInto (git.ts:669-674) tells to cherry -> reverseApply -> patchIdAggregate. Fixed spawn count independent of history depth; detection a strict superset; fail-safe preserved (never over-claims merged).

Literal pathspec: a >=2-commit distinct-diff branch touching a file named 'weird[1].txt', squash + later overlapping edit, cherry-dark precondition -> true. Empty-diff tip (commit then revert) -> false. Keep existing :44-94 cases green.

Run the origin pass only when originRef resolves AND !isAncestor(primaryCheckoutPath, originRef, target) — merged-on-origin is only possible when origin is ahead of local target; skipping when at/behind yields genuinely-unmerged (fail-safe) and halves cost in the common post-push state. Also introduce the shared pass-through spawnSync wrapper (vi.hoisted spawnControl{calls,beforeSpawn} + vi.mock('node:child_process') delegating to the real spawnSync) that Task 5 reuses.

tasks.name: obs#1 — distinct target-moved CAS outcome (workspace-service.ts)
tasks.description: mergeOrphanThenReap returns refused-changed on update-ref CAS failure (target advanced concurrently), conflating it with 'orphan changed'. Return a distinct 'target-moved' outcome instead (a plain retry recomputes against the advanced target). No type change (outcome is a plain string). Identify the CAS-failure return by its `// target moved concurrently` comment (line numbers shift after earlier tasks).

steps.description: RED (the CAS `expected` is snapshotted via rev-parse inside mergeOrphanThenReap at resolution time and the update-ref runs ~37 lines later, so the target must advance BETWEEN them — use the Task-3 spawn wrapper's beforeSpawn hook): surface a clean genuinely-unmerged orphan; const expected = git(root,'rev-parse','refs/heads/main'); let fired=false, concurrent=''; spawnControl.beforeSpawn = (args) => { if (!fired && args.includes('update-ref') && args.includes('refs/heads/main') && args[args.length-1]===expected) { fired=true; concurrent=git(root,'commit-tree', expected+'^{tree}','-p',expected,'-m','concurrent'); git(root,'update-ref','refs/heads/main',concurrent,expected); } }; resolveOrphan({resolutions:[{guid,action:'merge-then-reap'}]}). Assert fired===true (non-vacuous); outcome 'target-moved' (pre-fix 'refused-changed' -> RED); rev-parse refs/heads/main===concurrent (not clobbered); orphan branch tip unchanged; worktree present. Then spawnControl.beforeSpawn=null and re-run the same resolution -> 'merged-then-reaped' with main advanced past concurrent (proves the retry-succeeds semantics distinguishing target-moved from refused-changed).
